title: HNSW recall vs latency tradeoff at efSearch sweep
body:
Tuned HNSW parameters on a 1M sentence-embedding corpus.
[Step] Index build
  [Input] 1M × 768d float32, [Tool] hnswlib, [Parameter] M=16, efConstruction=200
[Step] Sweep
  [Parameter] efSearch ∈ {32, 64, 128, 256}, [Output] recall@10 = 0.81, 0.92, 0.97, 0.99
[Step] Latency
  [Tool] single-thread bench, [Output] p99 = 1.1, 1.8, 3.5, 7.2 ms
efSearch=128 hits the knee of the curve. Above 128 we pay nearly linear latency for diminishing recall, which matches the published HNSW behaviour.
